bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/ (retained views, animation), springboard/ui/src/anim.rs, springboard/ui/src/scroll.rs, springboard/apps/games-desktop/src/games.rs, springboard/render/src/gfx, springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs
summary: SpriteKit is a 2D scene, node, action, physics, particle and tile-map framework for games. BifrOSt has no 2D scene graph, physics world, particle system, tile map or shader API for apps. Its retained view tree, property animation, timing curves and image decoding cover the general UI counterparts only; the Games app (2048, Minesweeper, Klondike) is hand-written and does not use an engine.

features.note: Wave 5 (theme-14, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no scene object with an update loop, no game-scene presenter; apps get a retained UI view tree and a Surface

Nodes with position, rotation, scale, alpha, z order, hidden subtrees and a camera node that maps views to scenes are tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-35.rs. Gap: no view or window draws a node tree yet, and archived .sks scene files are not supported.

Apps draw into a Surface with damage tracking (the Games app does), and sk_node models rectangle, circle, label and image nodes whose paint-order draw list and view frames are tested headless. Gap: the draw list is not rasterised into a Surface yet, so text measurement and image decoding still belong to the renderer.
images decode to pixels; there is no GPU-side texture object, atlas packing or dynamically updatable texture for apps

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/animation.rs; springboard/ui/src/sk_action.rs (node action tree and runner); springboard/ui/src/sk_node.rs (NodeTree::run_action, advance_actions); wired: springboard/apps/games-desktop/src/tile_motion.rs (Sequence and TileMotion over springboard/ui/src/anim.rs Animation/Curve; used by games.rs shift, draw_2048, tick, next_wake)
features.note: Window::animate interpolates frame, opacity and background when a closure changes them. sk_action.rs adds composable actions (wait, report, sequence, group, counted and endless repeat) run by a Runner that reports fired ids, and sk_node.rs gives each scene node its own runner so reports carry the node that fired them. Gap: no window or view builds a node tree yet, so node actions run only in the headless tests in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-35.rs. built on parity/team-a-07; not yet verified on Midget

curves and springs exist as pure functions. Keyframes now give each key its own timing, hold or linear, and an easing curve for its segment, tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-35.rs. Gap: no node action uses Keyframes yet, so the timing modes apply only to the keyframe model. built on parity/team-a-07; not yet verified on Midget

Shader sources, attributes and uniform values are validated with tests. The system presenter runs no application shader, so validated descriptions are not yet drawn by any presenter.
Crop visibility, affine composition and filter validation are tested. Window transitions and blur still run in the shell, and nodes do not yet render their children into an offscreen filtered buffer.

features.feature: Renderer hand-off and custom Metal pipeline
features.note: SceneHandoff advances a presented scene once per update and gives the app a render pass (viewport in device pixels and scene time), refused until an update has run; tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-gaps-04.rs. Gap: the GPU presenter does not consume the hand-off yet, apps cannot reach it through the SDK, and there is no second GPU pipeline for apps (the presenter is Linux GPU code, docs/gpu-first.md).

gaps: No node or scene runs actions: sk_action.rs is a pure model with no SDK binding, so apps cannot attach an action to a view or node yet
No 2D scene graph with a per-frame update cycle and a camera node for apps (SKScene, SKCameraNode).
No physics world (rigid bodies, gravity, contacts, joints, fields); only list scroll deceleration exists in springboard/ui/src/scroll.rs.
No tile map system (SKTileMapNode and its tile set and rules).
No app-facing custom shader API (SKShader, SKUniform); shaders exist only inside the system presenter.
No texture atlas or GPU texture object (SKTexture, SKTextureAtlas).
No warp geometry or inverse-kinematics constraints (SKWarpGeometry, SKReachConstraints).
The Games app (springboard/apps/games-desktop/src/games.rs) is hand-written with no engine; it is not evidence of a reusable SpriteKit-style layer.
No per-key easing in keyframe sequences (SKKeyframeSequence timing modes); only linear and hold interpolation exist
